fields.Name: T279 - Home Pin Edit Mode
fields.Description: Exercises ToggleEditMode() and the EditMode-conditional template branch (drag handles, remove buttons, edit banner, add-pin card) — a distinct interaction mode not covered by the static pins-render test.

InputDefinition.goal: You are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Go to the Home landing page (Home icon/logo or application switcher dropdown). Ensure at least one pin exists in the 'Pinned' section (if none, first use 'Add Pin' to pin any Application nav item, then close the panel). Click the 'Edit' button in the Pinned section header (pencil icon). Verify edit mode engages: an edit-mode banner appears reading roughly 'Edit mode — Drag cards to reorder. Click names to rename.', each pin card shows a drag handle and a remove (x) control, and an 'Add Pin' placeholder card is shown. Then click 'Done' (check icon) and verify edit mode exits (banner and per-card controls disappear). Success is toggling into and back out of edit mode. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking 'Edit' shows the edit-mode banner and reveals per-pin drag handles / remove controls and an 'Add Pin' card
Clicking 'Done' exits edit mode and the banner and edit controls disappear
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
